title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander wellbeing
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:18Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point covers gaps linked to dispossession and Closing the Gap partnerships, but it does not teach that the gaps are shaped by remoteness or vary from place to place, so it is related rather than the same idea.

draft.title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander wellbeing
card: On average, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have a shorter life expectancy than other Australians. There are also gaps in health and in education.
These gaps are linked to dispossession, which is the removal of people from their land, and to past and present discrimination. They are not caused by who the people are.
Remoteness is also linked to the gaps. Many remote communities are far from hospitals, schools and jobs, so access to services can be harder.
The gaps are averages and they vary from place to place. Some communities and regions have smaller gaps than others, and many Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people have high wellbeing.
draft.remember: The gaps are averages linked to dispossession, discrimination and remoteness, and they differ between places.

a.q: Which statement about the wellbeing gaps for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples is correct?
opts: They are averages and vary from place to place
They are the same in every community in Australia
They are caused only by living in remote areas
They show that wellbeing cannot be improved
a.why: The gaps are averages, and the size of the gap differs between places. Remoteness is one linked factor, but the card also names dispossession and discrimination, so remoteness is not the only link.
a.clue: Think about the word on average.

b.q: A student says, "Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have lower average life expectancy because of who they are." Which reply is best supported?
opts: The gaps are linked to dispossession and discrimination
The gaps are linked only to the distance from cities
The gaps are linked to how many people live in each area
The gaps are linked to Aboriginal culture being unhealthy
b.why: The gaps are linked to dispossession and discrimination, not to the identity of the people. Remoteness is also linked, but saying it is the only link is wrong, because the card names other causes too.
b.clue: Look for a cause that is about what happened to people, not who they are.

a.best: They are averages and vary from place to place

b.best: The gaps are linked to dispossession and discrimination

problems.detail: The clue 'Think about the word on average' points straight at the only option that mentions averages, so a student can pick it without understanding the idea.
